capabilities: add and manage note annotations with replies, resolve/reopen and export
resize, align, crop and annotate images, and paste multi-image grids
insert content via a slash menu with Chinese/English/pinyin matching
apply colored highlights and convert pasted links into offline link cards
navigate via a floating collapsible outline and lightbox image viewer
disambiguation: Not a Feishu/Lark integration or sync tool; it only mimics the Feishu docs editing experience inside Obsidian.
extras: Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (Chinese/English) and documents public APIs (plugin.slashMenu.register, plugin.selectionActions.register) for third-party plugins, plus a data-fl-ui marker so other selection overlays can avoid its UI. Requires Obsidian 1.13.1+, MIT license.
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks Feishu/Lark-doc conveniences such as comment threads on selections, a pinyin-aware slash menu, image grids/captions and offline link cards.

relations.evidence: Lark-doc-style editing for Obsidian: annotations, image layout & crop-annotate, slash menu

summary: Editor enhancement suite that adds Feishu-doc-style annotations, a slash menu, image layout and annotation tools, colored highlights and link cards.
